dedupe_keys.name: opentransportdata swiss open data platform mobility switzerland

description: opentransportdata.swiss is the Open Data Platform Mobility Switzerland, operated by the Infrastructure Division of SBB on behalf of the Federal Office of Transport and financed by the Railway Infrastructure Fund. It publishes the national public transport data: timetable data, real-time and forecast data, event data, accessibility data, historical and statistical data, master data and metadata such as stops, the Open Journey Planner, and road traffic data through the integrated ASTRA Traffic Data Platform. Standards profiles for the sector are documented, and a cookbook explains the data and interfaces. Coverage is national for all Swiss public transport. Access: file-based data are free without registration, through downloads or the CKAN API at data.opentransportdata.swiss; service-based data need registration and an API key from the API manager, free below a request limit, with paid contracts for repeated higher use. Users may process, analyse and publish the data and must cite the source; the ASTRA traffic data follow FEDRO terms. Caveats: service quotas apply, and the formats of each feed are documented separately in the cookbook. The data support national public transport network flow, resilience and capacity planning models. They complement the Swiss railway network representations and the SBB open data platform catalogued here.
